title: Performance — NY RE Exam (iPad Landscape)
prompt:
iPad Pro 11 landscape screen, 1194x834, for a personal NY Real Estate Salesperson exam prep PWA. Same app and design system as the existing phone screens: dark OLED canvas #090d16, surfaces #111725 and #182033, ink #f1f5f9, secondary ink #a3b1c6. Design language "Wayfinding": New York transit signage. Headings in Helvetica Neue bold, tight tracking, sentence case. Every syllabus topic is a route bullet: a colored circle with a bold 1-character code, always next to the topic name. Route colors are topic identity only (red #DA291C codes 1 2 3, green #00843D codes 4 5 6, blue #0039A6 codes A C E, orange #FF6319 codes B D F M with dark text, yellow #FCCC0A codes N Q R W with dark text, purple #9B2A92 code 7, lime #6CBE45 code G with dark text). Status colors: go #10b981 (at or above the 70% pass line), stop #ef4444 (below 70%). Radius 24 hero sheets, 18 cards, 14 controls, full pills for chips and bullets. Elevation by surface lightness, no drop shadows except the floating tab bar. Numbers tabular, Helvetica Neue bold. Do NOT use all-caps eyebrow labels, middle-dot separated meta strings, or arrows inside buttons.

This is the tablet re-flow of the phone Performance screen (the Stats tab): it must use the extra width like a native iPadOS app, not a stretched phone column. Content area 1114px wide centered, 40px side gutters, 24px between sections. Large title "Performance" (34px) with a one-line subtitle "1,863 answers, 70% right".

Top band, full width: the signature "system map" of all 19 syllabus topics, styled like a subway service status board, with more columns than the phone: a dense 5 or 6 column grid of compact tiles in route-line order (red 1 2 3, green 4 5 6, blue A C E, orange B D F M, yellow N Q R W, purple 7, lime G). Each tile: route bullet, short topic name, accuracy percent in large tabular numerals. Tiles at or above 70% show the percent in green; below 70% the percent is red with a thin red outline; untested tiles are hollow and dimmed with a long dash. The legend (green dot "70% and up", red dot "Under 70%", hollow dot "Not tested") and a 56px primary green button "Retest weak areas" with a count pill "8 topics" sit together in one row under the map, the button not full width.

Below, two cards side by side: left (about 55%) "Accuracy by topic", weakest first: compact rows with route bullet, topic name, right-aligned percent and correct/answered, and a 6px bar with a tick at the 70% pass line; untested topics listed at the end, dimmed. Right (about 45%) "Quiz log": newest first, hairline dividers, each row tappable with a subtle chevron: PASS/FAIL pill, quiz title ("Mock NYS State Exam", "Quick 10-Question Drill", "Custom Study Quiz") with a secondary line "Oct 8, 58/75 correct", and a large right-aligned score percent.

Bottom: floating glass capsule tab bar, 600px wide, centered, 16px above the bottom edge, blurred translucent surface, 5 tabs with icon and label side by side in a row: Home, Build, Stats (active, go-green pill), Mistakes, More.
